ev.q: Most of the game is spent exploring and collecting items
Collectable items range from upgrades to Erina and Ribbon's weapons
Rabi-Ribi has been praised for the degree of customization it offers the player
a wide range of difficulty settings and modes to accommodate different skill levels
pitting the player against various bosses with dense bullet patterns
a fictional world where bunnies are worshiped
The game's soundtrack and originality have been met with approval
